newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in a quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in a quiet market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed unchanged at 42.5490/5495 to the dollar in a quiet session of the interbank market, dealers said.

Dealers said the local unit was quoted at 42.5485/5495 in early trade. "It was more or less a quiet session. Neither buyers nor sellers were as active as we expected. The reason could be a slowing down of imports," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed at 4.5 percent to 5.0 percent, down from Monday's 5.5-6.0 percent.
